mission.heading: Our Mission & Purpose
mission.intro: In today's fast-moving urban environment, running a comfortable, peaceful household requires support. Between long commutes on the IT corridor, demanding careers, caring for young babies, and looking after aging parents, families often feel stretched thin.
mission.story: {{name}} was established to provide Chennai residents with reliable, honest, and hardworking household staffing solutions. Rather than operating as an impersonal online directory or automated platform, we believe in hands-on matchmaking, understanding personal household preferences, and fostering long-term relationships between families and domestic staff.

leadership.heading: You Always Reach the Person in Charge
leadership.p1: The agency is personally directed by its owner, who oversees client enquiries, candidate interviews, and post-placement coordination. When you reach out to {{name}}, you speak directly with decision-makers who understand local Chennai communities, language considerations, and domestic expectations.
leadership.p2: We do not use impersonal call routing. Whether you message us on WhatsApp ({{whatsappDisplay}}) or call our phone lines, you reach a real person who addresses your requirements with prompt attention, honesty regarding candidate availability, and practical guidance.

verification.heading: Our Ethical Standards & Verification Approach
verification.intro: We take safety and integrity seriously. When registering domestic helpers, cooks, and caretakers, we implement practical, verified procedures:

steps.title: Government Identity Checks
steps.description: Verification of Aadhaar cards and official government identity proofs for every registered worker.

steps.title: Past Work References
steps.description: Discussion of prior household experience and domestic skillsets.

steps.title: Clarity on Roles & Duties
steps.description: Ensuring workers understand expected hours, daily tasks, hygiene expectations, and family guidelines.

steps.title: Fair Treatment & Dignity
steps.description: Promoting mutual respect, fair compensation, and safe work environments for domestic personnel.

coverage.heading: Our Deep Roots in Okkiyam Thoraipakkam & OMR
coverage.intro: Our office is conveniently located at:
coverage.outro: Being stationed right on the OMR tech corridor enables us to quickly assist households living in high-rise apartments, gated villa communities, and surrounding neighbourhoods like Perungudi, Sholinganallur, Velachery, and Adyar.

whyChooseUs.heading: Because the right help makes everyday life easier.
whyChooseUs.subtext: We treat household staffing as a relationship of trust. Here is why families across Chennai and Okkiyam Thoraipakkam count on our guidance:

items.title: Local Chennai Presence
items.description: Physically situated in Nehru Nagar, Okkiyam Thoraipakkam (Back Side Cognizant), giving us hands-on reach across the entire OMR tech corridor.

items.title: Diverse Household Staff
items.description: From morning cooks and full-day maids to specialized 24-hour infant nannies, elderly attendants, and family drivers — all under one trusted agency.

items.title: Identity & Record Checks
items.description: Every domestic worker's government identification (Aadhaar) and residential background are reviewed before being recommended to your household.

items.title: Direct WhatsApp Support
items.description: No automated IVR bots. You connect directly with the owner on WhatsApp to discuss your exact timings, dietary preferences, and expectations.

howItWorks.heading: From First Message
howItWorks.subtext: Most placements are confirmed within a week, not within a month. Four short steps — share what you need, meet a few verified candidates, settle terms, and start.

steps.title: Tell Us What You Need
steps.description: Share your service requirements, daily timings (part-time, day-shift, or live-in), family size, and locality in Chennai.

steps.title: Discuss Your Requirement
steps.description: We coordinate candidate options matching your preferences and arrange a direct phone or in-person discussion.

steps.title: Choose the Right Service
steps.description: Finalize working hours, scope of duties, and terms with clear mutual understanding before commencement.

steps.title: Get Started with Peace of Mind
steps.description: Your helper commences duties, with {{name}} remaining available for ongoing coordination.

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.desc: WhatsApp your locality, your shift and the duties that matter. Thirty seconds of typing is the whole first step.

steps.title: See matched profiles
steps.desc: You get verified candidates whose experience and locality fit your home. You talk to them before deciding — never a blind assignment.

steps.title: Start with an introduction
steps.desc: Once you choose, the person starts. You keep one number for anything that comes after.

verifyBand.heading: What's checked before anyone enters your home
verifyBand.subline: Whoever is placed with you has had their ID checked, references spoken to, and duties clarified with you before day one. You see the verification details before they start.
